name: Tokyo Seimitsu Co., Ltd.
summary: Tokyo Seimitsu Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells semiconductor manufacturing equipment and measuring instruments in Japan, China, Taiwan, South Korea, rest of East Asia, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers wafer dicing and probing machines, polish and high rigid grinders, wafer manufacturing machines, chemical mechanical planarizers, edge shaping products, sliced wafer demounting and cleaning machines, precision dicing blades, and equipment for dicing and probing machines.
